description: This file contains unit tests for the function 'filterCardsAND', which filters a list of card objects based on multiple criteria such as assignees, priorities, statuses, columns, and due dates. The tests verify that the filtering logic correctly produces the expected subsets of cards under various conditions.

methods.name: filterCardsAND
methods.description: Filters an array of card objects based on multiple filter criteria. Returns only cards that meet all specified conditions, including assignee, priority, status, column, and due date constraints.
